info.title: OpenGrid Data API
info.description: Real-time GPU compute market data: prices, indices, fixings, capacity, costs, reliability, events and news.

tags.name: Reference
tags.description: GPUs, families, providers and regions: the ids every other route uses.

tags.name: Markets
tags.description: One row per GPU across every provider: price range, spread and history.

tags.name: Listings
tags.description: Every individual offer as the provider publishes it.

tags.name: Reserved
tags.description: Reserved and committed-term prices beside on-demand.

tags.name: Indices
tags.description: OpenGrid's GPU price indices and their levels over time.

tags.name: Fixings
tags.description: Official fixings: exact decimal values in a verifiable hash chain.

tags.name: Capacity
tags.description: What providers report as in stock, by SKU and region.

tags.name: Costs
tags.description: Egress, storage, billing increments, and the full cost of a job.

tags.name: FX
tags.description: The reference exchange rates used to convert non-USD prices.

tags.name: Reliability
tags.description: OpenGrid's own probes of provider APIs, plus provider-reported incidents.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Market events and major shifts detected in the data.

tags.name: News
tags.description: Story-clustered GPU market news and the timeline around price moves.

tags.name: Macro
tags.description: Public context series (power, filings) beside prices.

tags.name: Methodology
tags.description: How every number is computed, as machine-readable documents.

tags.name: Bulk exports
tags.description: One completed UTC day of a dataset as a gzipped JSON-lines file.
